scope: Bind persisted Zema cloud-agent plan progress to exact owner/parent-scoped A2A delegation evidence.

implementation.plan: The existing WorkJob cloud-agent template persists ordered brief/quote and result-review steps with revisioned event records.
implementation.progressBinding: Cloud-agent record commands retain a syntactically validated delegation ID. The authenticated work-jobs API verifies the referenced delegation belongs to the same owner and parent.
implementation.quoteStep: Requires a persisted provider-signed quote object and matching stored quote digest.
implementation.resultStep: Requires remote_completed, artifacts_captured, at least one persisted artifact row, and an owner/parent-bound usage receipt.
implementation.reviewGuard: Previously recorded evidence is rechecked before every subsequent plan mutation, including final completion.
implementation.offlineExecution: This links UI progress to existing durable cloud job state; it does not create new cloud work or auto-dispatch a successor.

limitations: The Cloud Agent plan is a fixed two-step template, not a user-authored or LLM-authored extensible plan schema.
Tests use local Worker/D1 fixtures and synthetic usage. Production D1 readback is 0/6.
A stored signed usage receipt is not an invoice or payment settlement proof.
Real provider task execution, carrier activation, hardware onboarding, and OS installation are not established.
